subject: ACK render v3 ABI: n2r_draw_options mapping
body: ACK render's delta3 ABI. n2r side is present: int n2r_validate_v3(shader,q,texture_resources*,const struct n2r_draw_options*); int n2r_build_v3(out[N2R_BLOCK],shader,q,addresses,texture_resources*,options*,index,next). struct n2r_draw_options {u32 version=1; u32 flags; int32 vertex_base; u32 base_instance;}; flags FLAT_SHADING=1/WRITE_VERTEX_BASE=2/WRITE_BASE_INSTANCE=4. Map Dispatch genericDrawFlags/genericVertexBase/genericBaseInstance directly to these. Semantics match render's item4: q->vertex stays the existing per-vertex vertexStart/baseVertex rebased attribute base; n2r writes signed vertex_base at FAU byte64 and does NOT add it to attributes again; n2r adds baseInstance*stride only to input_rate ATTRIBUTE rows and writes base_instance at FAU byte68; both require vertex_fau_words 17/18. Primitive base_vertex_offset stays0. FLAT_SHADING sets TILER_CONTEXT.first_provoking_vertex (v9 word2 bit18). Caveat: pinned v9.xml has no DRAW.flat_shading_vertex; n2r does not fabricate the overloaded word0 bit8; triangle flat is implemented, line-list flat remains an explicit source-backed gap. Host test test_draw_options covers tiler/FAU/BI attr rebase/default byte stability. n2mb_draw_v3 is compute-owned; please add as requested.
